mostWorthwhile.text: Aerobic ATP renewal was the most worthwhile construction: its planned picture distinguishes fuel oxidation, oxygen's role and the hydrogen-ion gradient driving ATP synthase. The sequence is dense, but those connections have educational value.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the glucose carrier was straightforward setup; the following transport sequence did more to explain how the carrier works.

surprise.text: Placing glucose in the cell interior immediately produced glycolysis and cytosolic ATP renewal, rather than just positioning the glucose.

arbitrary.text: Pairing aerobic ATP renewal directly with amino acids felt somewhat shorthand for protein synthesis. The result clarifies the roles of ribosomes and existing RNA, but not the individual energy-coupling steps.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: the comparison between powered pumping and passive sodium flow made a useful structural and functional distinction.
